output.title: Output
output.replaceNumshb: Writes temporary NUMSHB, NUMDLB, and both NUMATB files. NUSKTB is generated only to satisfy conversion and is not applied to the target. JNTTBL, NUHLPB, textures, and structure JSON stay untouched.
output.replaceFull: Converted files overwrite the current model slot. The model name, order, and NUHLPB stay on the target.
output.unitModel: Generated model files are registered under the Unit model models folder{{stageRoot}}. Referenced textures are deduplicated into its shared texture pool.
output.batchDirect: These SSBH and NUMATB settings are shared by all {{count}} files. Each model is written directly to its own disk folder.
output.direct: SSBH files are written directly to the selected disk folder.
output.memory: SSBH files are kept in memory until you save the stage folder{{stageRoot}}.
output.batchFolderName: Each output folder uses its source FBX/DAE filename.
output.flipUvHelp: Invert the V coordinate during SSBH conversion.
